scientific_integrity: All advertised limits and signs are consequences of the exact polynomial identities, global diagonal contraction, scalar monotonicity and smooth hyperbolic stable-manifold invariance; exact finite computations are corroborative and not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified deterministic Euler mean-field three-node triangle, not the exact finite-state stochastic SIS process.
Variance and cubic boundary expansions, and opposite-outcome paired seeds, are local for sufficiently small centered perturbations.
Unindexed or inaccessible literature may contain equivalent special cases; no independent audit has been performed.
title: Variance-to-skewness reversal of epidemic seeding on a three-agent simplex
